addr: 485, Sampige Rd, Malleshwaram, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560003, India

rev.t: One of the oldest stationery shops in Bengaluru. All kinds of stationery items are available including school and college text books. Good customer service. I have been buying items from them for many years.
Very good books. Hymamshu school books arre there

One of the best places to buy books in Malleshwaram area. One can get a large collection school and college books, though discounts provided are not much. Apart from books a variety of general stationery items are also sold here. Staffs here have low patience while attending customers.
